screening_attempts.reason: Screening was inconclusive; held for operator review
screening_attempts.quarantine_resolution_reason: Policy v13 operator release of crown-v201 v1, exact SHA bd78ae1a...052647fbb, attempt 4da06b56. Hold was l3-violation-adjudicator-disagreement with no verified finding: no L2 finding or adjudication was recorded (finding null), and the evidence row says the private source review did not produce a usable result (seed envelope 45 MiB of 8192 MiB). The leads are the L1 notes, and the adjudicator disagreed with them. Diff against same-hotkey crown-v199 (8c1cf17c, scored): 35 files, 31 byte-identical, 4 modified, none added or removed. Every L1 I5 note (guide_records.py:6-237, records.py:29-180) cites files byte-identical to v199 and to the v197/v198 releases. They are fixed advisory notes for the deciding model, selected by request wording (guide_records.py:192-256 record_notes/notes), under the 2026-10-23 routed-guidance safe harbor. The I7 note on route.py:327 is refuted: route_by_catalog only feeds order_by_route (route.py:322-324), which sorts the full catalog, and Surface (surface.py:49-53) keeps every tool. The short.py:321 FRAME_TEMPLATES note (short.py:321-338, frame_like) is unchanged from v199. It only skips the opening and closing lines of a story note when picking the advisory recent-passage lines (short.py:351), which is W3 record selection, not answer authority. Deltas vs v199: (1) agent.py:121-126 drops tools whose own description ends 'Needs the <App> connector to be linked in Settings.' from the catalog. The public v15 contract fixes that suffix 'so a harness can tell a linkable connector from a product tool' (research/dittobench-datagen/catalog/v15.go:635). Those connectors are not linked, the endpoint refuses every one, and no case expects one (v15.go:21-28). That is a W4 availability ground keyed on the runtime tool contract, not a guess from request wording (cf. Lucas_v10 v7), so I7 is not established. The filter does not branch on bench_version, case id or seed, so I8 is clear. (2) short.py:133-155 same_statement/filed_lead shows same-day near-identical statements once, with a count, in the advisory lead. The full notes still follow (short.py:195 record_view), which is W3 dedupe. (3) typography.py:38-46 folds U+2018/U+2019/U+02BC to ASCII apostrophes: request-independent, character-level W8. (4) DECLARATION.md documents P101/P102. Answer authority is unchanged: agent.py:195 returns plain_type(outcome.content) with tool_calls=executor.observed. answer.py, action.py and records.py are byte-identical to v199, and no host compare, retry-until-match, rebuild or substitution exists. Copy: uc3 not flagged (top score 3.25 of 100, Hades v19; released base dan0l v30 excluded). No I1-I8 or S1-S3 ground found. Static diff review only; exact UUID only.
